class op2_loop_body:
    var_ranges = {p0: 896}
    index0 = p0
    index1 = 0
    def body(self, ops):
        get_index = self.get_index('index0')
        load = ops.load('buf0', get_index)
        get_index_1 = self.get_index('index1')
        load_1 = ops.load('buf1', get_index_1)
        constant = ops.constant(896.0, torch.float32)
        truediv = ops.truediv(load_1, constant)
        constant_1 = ops.constant(1e-06, torch.float32)
        add = ops.add(truediv, constant_1)
        rsqrt = ops.rsqrt(add)
        mul = ops.mul(load, rsqrt)
        to_dtype = ops.to_dtype(mul, torch.bfloat16, src_dtype = torch.float32, use_compute_types = True)
        get_index_2 = self.get_index('index0')
        load_2 = ops.load('arg2_1', get_index_2)
        mul_1 = ops.mul(to_dtype, load_2)
        get_index_3 = self.get_index('index0')
        store = ops.store('buf2', get_index_3, mul_1, None)
        return store
